title: The other parent
prompt:
Clone all branches and tags. At tag confluence, ignore the first parent.
Follow the second parent's first-parent chain. Take only messages beginning capsule.
Put them in ascending capsule index, XOR each hex byte with the repeating ASCII answer of What was removed.
Decode ASCII. This is constructed archival fiction, not a claim about historical events.
Tags are voices too. One lacuna names an absence.
